answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A jade of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
